lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's San Miguel County commissioners meeting, where four public hearings on a brand-new Natural Resources article — covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations — could reshape how extraction and land use are governed across the county for years to come. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission also takes up Land Use Code and Master Plan updates Monday night, and Ouray City Council holds first readings on 2027 water and sewer rates plus a Light Industrial zoning ordinance. Closer to home, HARC takes up the Shandoka Lot redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd, and the school board revisits the ongoing mill levy override conversation.
